summary: Phase 4 verification: fill_form dispatcher wired to all 5 forms, ghost-typing overlay, Multi-Company Phase 1 and regression items. All 5 forms (shipment_new, invoice_new, party_new, ledger_entry_new, trip_new) correctly consume window.__testDispatchFill payloads, navigate to the right route, and apply fields. WingmanFillOverlay is mounted in _layout.tsx, shows AI purple->green->cyan gradient (0.55 opacity) pinned at top with paddingTop=insets.top, cycles field ticker every ~800 ms, auto-dismisses ~3.5 s, and dismisses immediately on tap. Backend multi-company endpoints (GET /api/companies, GET /api/companies/co_singh_exports/summary, POST /api/auth/login for bsingh) return correct payloads. Admin (kishan) sidebar shows company-switcher toggling Awadh <-> Singh Exports and API calls carry ?company=<id>. Regression: notification bell hidden on all 5 form routes, hamburger works, VaultSnapshot testIDs vault-india + vault-bangkok present, voice-orb long-press panel opens with 4 controls (mic, mute, close, send + input). One bug: Papa (bsingh) sidebar does NOT show a Singh Exports brand indicator; the CompanySwitcher renders null for non-Admin and no fallback header is rendered.

ui_bugs.issue: Papa (bsingh) sidebar is missing the 'Singh Exports' brand indicator. CompanySwitcher (src/components/company-switcher.tsx:26) returns null when user.role !== 'Admin'. Sidebar has no fallback static company header for Papa/Staff/Carrier, so the top of Papa's sidebar has no company text at all (only 'LogiOp Pro' logo + FYPicker). Reference: src/components/sidebar.tsx:242-246 & src/components/company-switcher.tsx:26.

action_items: In src/components/sidebar.tsx (around line 242-246, inside the header block), render a static role-locked company label for non-Admin users. Something like: {user?.role !== 'Admin' && <View><Text>{BRAND_LABELS[activeCompany]?.label ?? 'Singh Exports'}</Text></View>} so Papa's sidebar shows 'Singh Exports' (and Staff sees their brand). Keep CompanySwitcher visible for Admin only, per current design.
critical_code_review_comments: fill-form-bus.ts exposes window.__testDispatchFill unconditionally on web (line 80-83). Fine for dev/preview but should be gated behind __DEV__ / NODE_ENV !== 'production' before shipping to a real production build.

WingmanFillOverlay auto-dismiss timer is restarted on every dispatch (good) but there's no cleanup on unmount for dismissTimerRef (line 108-109). Add clearTimeout on unmount to avoid setState-after-unmount warnings during navigation.

CompanyProvider.setActiveCompany short-circuits when c === activeCompany (line 85). Persistence of the initial hydrated value therefore never fires, but that's OK because AsyncStorage was already read. Non-blocking.
seed_data_creation: None. Used existing seeded users (kishan, bsingh) and seeded companies co_awadh_enterprise / co_singh_exports.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 5 fill_form flows now work via window.__testDispatchFill and the WingmanFillOverlay animates correctly with the AI gradient. The single outstanding issue is that Papa's sidebar has no static company header. After the main agent adds a role-locked brand label, verify by logging in as bsingh, opening the hamburger, and confirming 'Singh Exports' text appears near the top of the sidebar (above the nav items).
rca_of_issue: Papa sidebar missing brand indicator: The Sidebar header (src/components/sidebar.tsx:241-246) unconditionally renders <CompanySwitcher /> when showLabels is true. CompanySwitcher (src/components/company-switcher.tsx:26) returns null unless user.role === 'Admin'. There is no alternative branch that renders a static Text label for Papa/Staff/Carrier, so the sidebar has no visible company context for those roles. Fix: conditionally render either the switcher (Admin) or a plain <Text> pill with BRAND_LABELS[activeCompany].label (non-Admin). Reproduction: log in as bsingh / Papa@2026 -> tap hamburger -> observe the top of the sidebar has 'LogiOp Pro' and FY picker but no 'Singh Exports' text.
